web-guide-idea-44.audience: Creators who want better short videos using their existing phone.
web-guide-idea-44.offer: Teach one improvement at a time: framing, light, sound or editing. End with a small clip the participant has made.
web-guide-idea-44.steps.0: Review a short sample and choose one priority.
web-guide-idea-44.steps.1: Practise a simple shot near window light.
web-guide-idea-44.steps.2: Edit a short sequence and compare it with the starting version.
web-guide-idea-44.equipment: The participant’s phone with a camera and a basic editor. A stand and earphones are useful extras, not compulsory purchases.
web-guide-idea-44.returnReason: A later session can focus on sound, captions or storytelling after the first skill is practised.
web-guide-idea-44.promotion: Share a phone-shot before-and-after example and say which skill the session targets.
